description: Core intelligence + pipeline + samples: the local NlpAnalyzer, the real RuleValidator (7 business rules with location+evidence+explanation and HIGH->risk-alert), the template-based DraftGenerator (FTN/FTP/Carta, structured+Markdown, placeholders+finding markers), the pipeline orchestrator (extract->analyze->validate->alerts->draft->persist) with the local provider bundle wired through the selector, two seeded sample documents, and the required unit + integration tests. Depends on FEAT-001. Mirrors plan.md items 3,4,7.
steps: Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\local\local-nlp-analyzer.ts implementing NlpAnalyzer deterministically (no network): extract candidate entities (money, dates, org names, item descriptions) and key phrases from text; return stable, testable output.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\rules\rule-definitions.ts: an array of rule objects { id, severity, category, evaluate(extracted)->Finding[] } implementing exactly the plan.md table — R-CAMPO-OBLIGATORIO, R-PRESUPUESTO-CDP (valorSinIva>cdpValor), R-VALOR-INCONSISTENTE (sin-IVA vs total-con-IVA presented as the same 'valor maximo'), R-MARCA-CERRADA (closed brand like Mac/Apple without 'o equivalente'), R-EXPERIENCIA-RESTRICTIVA (>=N units AND a second specific implementation jointly), R-FECHAS-COHERENTES (fechaCierre<=fechaPublicacion or plazo<=0/>1800d), R-MODALIDAD-CUANTIA (minima cuantia modality but value over threshold). Each finding has message (technical explanation), evidence (quoted text), location, and riskAlert for HIGH-severity ones. NO rule may always-pass or always-fail.
Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\local\local-rule-validator.ts: implements RuleValidator by running every rule in rule-definitions over ExtractedData and flattening the findings.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\local\local-draft-generator.ts: implements DraftGenerator; builds DraftSection[] for FTN (negociacion), FTP (producto/items) and Carta de intencion; fills fields from ExtractedData; emits `[[COMPLETAR: <label>]]` for missing fields; marks fields touched by a finding with the findingId + a visible warning; applies ACCEPT/REJECT decisions when provided; renders the full Markdown `content`.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\index.ts: `getProviders()` returns the local ProviderBundle (extractor/analyzer/validator/generator/storage/traceStore/searchIndex). When config.provider==='aws' it `await import('./aws/index.js')` dynamically (that module is added in FEAT-004; guard so the local path never imports it). Export an async getProviders() plus a sync buildLocalProviders().

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\pipeline\pipeline.ts: `runPipeline(input, providers)` -> extract, analyze, validate, derive alerts (findings with riskAlert), generate draft, persist document+findings+version to TraceStore/Storage, index findings in SearchIndex; returns DocumentRecord. Wrap each stage so a stage error is surfaced with context (no silent failure).

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\samples\estudio_previo_pgn_limpio.txt: a realistic PGN AGL-2026-PGN41 estudio previo (entidad, objeto tecnologia, valor sin IVA, CDP, items, plazo 05-dic-2026) that is internally consistent.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\samples\estudio_previo_pgn_inconsistencias.txt: same case but seeded with the demo defects — FTN valor sin IVA ($51.460.675.487) vs Carta total con IVA ($61.587.261.594) presented as the same max value, closed brand 'Mac Studio/MacBook/iPad' on items 3-5 without 'o equivalente', and restrictive experience (>=500 equipos AND an audiencias-platform implementation).

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\scripts\seed.ts: loads the inconsistencias sample through runPipeline and prints the resulting documentId + finding count (used by `bun run seed`; also handy for manual demo).

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\tests\rules\rule-validator.test.ts (bun:test): happy path (clean sample -> no HIGH alerts) + edges: (a) valorSinIva>cdpValor emits R-PRESUPUESTO-CDP HIGH alert, (b) sin-IVA/con-IVA mismatch emits R-VALOR-INCONSISTENTE, (c) closed-brand item emits R-MARCA-CERRADA, (d) missing mandatory `objeto` emits R-CAMPO-OBLIGATORIO HIGH, (e) fechaCierre<=fechaPublicacion emits R-FECHAS-COHERENTES. Assert specific ruleId/severity/evidence — no assert-true.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\tests\draft\draft-generator.test.ts (bun:test): happy path produces FTN+FTP+Carta sections with non-empty Markdown; edge (missing field) -> `[[COMPLETAR:` placeholder present; edge (finding on a field) -> that field is flagged with the findingId.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\tests\pipeline\pipeline.integration.test.ts (bun:test): read samples/estudio_previo_pgn_inconsistencias.txt, run runPipeline with buildLocalProviders(), assert >=3 findings incl. >=1 HIGH risk alert, a draft version exists in TraceStore, and SearchIndex returns a hit for a term from one finding.
acceptance_criteria: `bun test tests/rules tests/draft tests/pipeline` all pass.
The inconsistencias sample yields >=3 findings including >=1 HIGH-severity risk alert, each with location + textual evidence + technical explanation.
The generated draft is a real editable document (sections + Markdown) with placeholders for missing fields and markers for flagged fields.
`bunx tsc --noEmit` stays clean; no rule or test uses an always-true/always-pass assertion.

RULE DEFINITIONS (src/rules/rule-definitions.ts):
- Exports: interface RuleDefinition {id, severity, category, evaluate(extracted)->Finding[]}; RULES: RuleDefinition[] (the 7 rules, ordered); formatCOP(n)->string (dotted-thousands, deterministic, NO Intl); MINIMA_CUANTIA_THRESHOLD=211_000_000; MAX_PLAZO_DIAS=1800; valueOf(located).
- Finding id scheme is STABLE/deterministic: R-CAMPO-OBLIGATORIO:<fieldKey>; R-PRESUPUESTO-CDP; R-VALOR-INCONSISTENTE; R-MARCA-CERRADA:item-<numero>; R-EXPERIENCIA-RESTRICTIVA; R-FECHAS-COHERENTES:orden and R-FECHAS-COHERENTES:plazo; R-MODALIDAD-CUANTIA.
- riskAlert attached per plan.md table (level === severity): R-CAMPO-OBLIGATORIO only when HIGH (objeto/valorSinIva missing); R-PRESUPUESTO-CDP, R-VALOR-INCONSISTENTE, R-MODALIDAD-CUANTIA (all HIGH); R-MARCA-CERRADA, R-EXPERIENCIA-RESTRICTIVA (MEDIUM, table says yes). R-FECHAS-COHERENTES has NO riskAlert.
- IMPORTANT rule semantics (so later features/samples stay consistent): R-VALOR-INCONSISTENTE fires only when valorSinIva && valorTotalConIva && cdpValor are present AND sinIva!==conIva AND cdpValor===conIva (i.e. the CDP backs the con-IVA figure while the budget is declared sin IVA). In the LIMPIO sample CDP===valorSinIva so it does NOT fire. R-PRESUPUESTO-CDP fires when valorSinIva>cdpValor. R-MARCA-CERRADA scans item descripcion+marca for closed brands (mac/macbook/imac/ipad/iphone/apple/intel core iN) and skips when 'o equivalente' is present. R-EXPERIENCIA-RESTRICTIVA fires when experienciaExigida has a quantity of equipos/unidades/bienes/computadores AND a second-requirement keyword (plataforma/implementaci/audiencias/software/solucion integral). R-MODALIDAD-CUANTIA fires when modalidad matches /minima cuantia/ AND valorSinIva>threshold.

PROVIDER SELECTOR (src/providers/index.ts): exports buildLocalProviders(): ProviderBundle (sync, all 7 local impls) and async getProviders(config=defaultConfig): Promise<ProviderBundle>. For provider==='aws' it dynamically imports './aws/index.ts' via a NON-LITERAL specifier (so tsc does not resolve the not-yet-existent module) and expects it to export buildAwsProviders(config): ProviderBundle. FEAT-004 MUST create src/providers/aws/index.ts exporting `export function buildAwsProviders(config: AppConfig): ProviderBundle`. The local path never imports the aws module.

PIPELINE (src/pipeline/pipeline.ts): exports interface PipelineInput extends ExtractorInput { documentId?: string; metadata?: {entidad?,procesoId?} } and async runPipeline(input: PipelineInput, providers: ProviderBundle): Promise<DocumentRecord>. Stages: extract -> analyze(persists nlp/<id>.json blob) -> validate -> alerts (findings.riskAlert) -> draft -> persist. Each stage wrapped: errors rethrown as `runPipeline: stage "<name>" failed: ...`. documentId = input.documentId || randomUUID(). Persist order: traceStore.saveDocument(record status=DRAFTED) FIRST, then storage.put draft at key `drafts/<id>/draft.md`, then traceStore.addVersion (version assigned by store, draft.version synced), then searchIndex.index(findings, id). Returns the persisted DocumentRecord (re-fetched). FEAT-005 server routes should call runPipeline for POST /documents/upload.

DRAFT GENERATOR (src/providers/local/local-draft-generator.ts): generate() returns DraftDocument with documentId='' and version=1 (the PIPELINE overrides documentId after generate and version after addVersion). Sections ids: 'ftn','ftp','carta'. Each DraftField {label,value,editable:true,placeholder?,flaggedByFindingId?}. Missing source value => value:'' and placeholder `[[COMPLETAR: <label>]]`. A field is flagged when a finding.location.field === the field's domain key (items fields disambiguate by finding id suffix `item-<numero>`). Decisions applied: REJECT dismisses the flag (flaggedByFindingId cleared), ACCEPT keeps it and the Markdown notes '(observación aceptada)'. Markdown content includes '## Ficha Técnica de Negociación (FTN)', '## Ficha Técnica de Producto (FTP)', '## Carta de intención'.

NLP ANALYZER (src/providers/local/local-nlp-analyzer.ts): analyze(text)->{entities:[{text,type,score}], keyPhrases:[{text,score}]}. Deterministic: entities typed ORG/MONEY/DATE (deduped, ORG first); keyPhrases are top-10 freq tokens (len>=4, stopword-filtered), sorted by count desc then alpha. Throws if text is not a string.

FIELD-KEY -> DRAFT mapping (for UI/server): entidad, objeto, modalidad, valorSinIva, plazoEjecucion (FTN); items (FTP); entidad, objeto, valorTotalConIva, experienciaExigida, fechaCierre (Carta).

TEST QUIRKS honored: workspace-local .data/test-* dirs (never os.tmpdir); provider bundles constructed with explicit baseDir overrides in the integration test; redirect bun/tsc output to a file to read real stdout under PowerShell.
